import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/test_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/test_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/test_3.csv"
]

# Label mapping based on source label values to target integer labels
label_map = {
    'g': 1,
    'r': 1,
    'purple': 1,
    'b': 1
}

# List to hold transformed DataFrames
dfs = []

for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Ensure columns are exactly ['x', 'y', 'label']
    # According to source info, all have these columns
    
    # Convert 'label' column from string to integer using label_map
    # Defensive: strip and lower to avoid mismatch due to spaces or case
    df['label'] = df['label'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().map(label_map)
    
    # If any label is unmapped (NaN), raise error to catch unexpected labels
    if df['label'].isnull().any():
        unmapped = df.loc[df['label'].isnull(), 'label']
        raise ValueError(f"Unmapped label values found in {file_path}: {unmapped.unique()}")
    
    # Convert 'x' to integer by rounding (since source x is float, target x is integer)
    # Use round then convert to int
    df['x'] = df['x'].round().astype(int)
    
    # Convert 'y' to float (should already be float, but enforce)
    df['y'] = df['y'].astype(float)
    
    # Reorder columns to target schema order: ['y', 'x', 'label']
    df = df[['y', 'x', 'label']]
    
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the same schema as target, union (concat) all
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
